raw_segments.text: Kalia opened the door to peep at the kids.
They were both sitting as before at the table, not reading but warmly disputing about something.
The children often argued together about various exciting problems of life, and Nastya, being
the elder, always got the best of it.
If Kastya did not agree with her, he almost always appealed to Kalia Krasetkin, and his
verdict was regarded as infallible by both of them.
This time the kids, discussion rather interested Krasetkin, and he stood still in the passage
The children saw he was listening, and that made them dispute with even greater energy.
